purpose: The single validated measurement construction the stateful-core mechanism build scores against (design doc D3).

gate_a.note: MiniLM does NOT clear gate A at this difficulty; BGE-small only.

gate_b.control: random-init SAME-architecture TinyTransformer (model_cfg of exp_scale_meaning_learn_arc_heldout_v2), matched MEAN_POOL readout
gate_b.note: seed=101 solves it structurally at +0.075 -> NOT bulletproof.

distE5_distEv8.verdict: did not help: gate B still near-threshold AND gate A became fragile (1/3 resamples no reader passed)

mandatory_build_guard: Run random-init control across >=5 seeds; the trained stateful core must beat the WORST-case (max ~0.075) random-init margin, NOT the mean, AND beat the static-encoder baseline. A mechanism margin below ~0.08 is indistinguishable from a lucky random-init and must not be claimed as comprehension.
